examples.arabic: بعد قليل، سمعوا صوت سيارة أبيهم.
examples.english: After a little while, they heard the sound of their father's car.
examples.transliteration: Ba'da qaleel, sami'u sawta sayyarati abeehim.
examples.storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

examples.arabic: شربنا القهوة معا وتحدثنا عن تفاصيل حياتنا اليومية بعد كل هذه السنوات
examples.english: We drank coffee together and talked about the details of our daily lives after all these years
examples.transliteration: Sharibna al qahwa maan wa tahaddathna an tafasil hayatina al yawmiyya bada kulla hadhihi as sanawat
examples.storyTitle: A Surprise Meeting at the Cafe

examples.arabic: يقدم ابي هدية جميلة لاخي بعد تناول العشاء
examples.english: My father presents a beautiful gift to my brother after eating dinner.
examples.transliteration: Yuqaddimu abee hadiyyatan jameelatan liakhee bada tanaawul alashaa

examples.arabic: بعد ساعات طويلة اصبح الطبق جاهزا والرائحة كانت شهية جدا
examples.english: After long hours, the dish was ready, and the smell was very delicious.
examples.transliteration: Ba'da sa'at tawilah asbaha at-tabaq jahizan wa ar-ra'ihah kanat shahiyyah jiddan.

examples.arabic: بعد ان اعادت الفستان بنجاح شعرت براحة كبيرة وزاد نشاطها
examples.english: After successfully returning the dress, she felt great comfort and her energy increased
examples.transliteration: Ba'da an a'adat al-fustan bi-najah sha'arat bi-rahah kabirah wa zada nashatuha

examples.arabic: بعد شهور من الجهد والاجتماعات المكثفة اقترب موعد اليوم المنتظر بفارغ الصبر
examples.english: After months of intense effort and meetings, the eagerly awaited day approached.
examples.transliteration: Ba'da shuhour min al-juhd wal-ijtima'at al-mukaththafah iqtaraba maw'id al-yawm al-muntazar bi-farigh al-sabr.
